title: BTCS Prepares DeFi Business To Provide Liquidity For Tokenized Stocks
summary: BTCS says its Imperium DeFi unit has completed preparatory compliance steps for potential use of the SEC’s Covered Firm exemption. The company has submitted the required notice and published relevant disclosures. Imperium has not yet started providing tokenized-equity liquidity because a qualifying Tokenized Securities Venue must first become operational.

title: 21Shares Sets New Staking Payouts Across Five Crypto ETFs
summary: 21Shares has declared September staking distributions for five crypto ETFs covering Ethereum, Solana, Hyperliquid, Sui and Polkadot. The largest per-share distribution is $0.191360 for the Hyperliquid Staking ETF. The funds distribute staking rewards generated by their underlying proof-of-stake assets to shareholders.

title: Circle Brings USDC Workflows Into Banking Platform Used By Major Institutions
summary: Volante Technologies and Circle have announced a collaboration around stablecoin payment and settlement infrastructure. Volante plans to bring USDC workflows into the same payment platform banks already use for conventional rails. The work covers areas including minting, redemption, wallet registration, funding and wallet-to-wallet payments.

title: Soluna And Bitdeer Add 7 MW To Texas Bitcoin Mining Deal
summary: Soluna and Bitdeer have expanded their Project Kati 1 agreement by approximately 7 MW. Bitdeer’s total deployment at the wind-powered Texas site will rise to 35 MW and about 2.42 EH/s. The additional capacity is expected to be deployed by November and fully books the K1BC phase of the project.

title: DeFi Development Corp Adds 47,706 SOL As Treasury Passes 2.5M Tokens
summary: DeFi Development Corp added approximately 47,706 SOL and SOL equivalents since September 21. Total holdings have reached roughly 2.538 million SOL and equivalents, valued by the company at about $309 million. The treasury has grown around 10% since the company’s August 12 earnings update.

title: Strategy Buys 1,665 More Bitcoin And Spends $152M Buying Back STRC
summary: Strategy bought 1,665 BTC for approximately $142.7 million between September 21 and September 27. The company now holds 847,666 BTC acquired for about $63.95 billion in total. Strategy also repurchased roughly $151.7 million of STRC preferred shares during the same week.

title: Oracle Connects Bank Payment Systems To Swift’s Blockchain Ledger
summary: Oracle is integrating its banking and blockchain infrastructure with Swift’s shared ledger for tokenized deposits. Banks can connect their own tokenized-deposit systems to cross-bank payment flows while retaining control of the underlying assets. Oracle Banking Payments will link those digital-asset flows with existing ISO 20022 processing.

title: TRON DAO Celebrates Canary Staked TRX ETF (Ticker: TRXS) Debut With Cboe Closing Bell in Chicago
summary: Geneva, Switzerland, September 29, 2026 — TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), will ring the closing bell at Cboe Global Markets’ trading floor in Chicago today, September 29, to celebrate the listing of TRXS, an exchange-traded product offering staked exposure to TRX, the native token of the TRON network. The milestone reflects the TRON network’s growing adoption across traditional financial markets, with TRXS giving institutions access to TRX through participating brokerages. Listed on Cboe on September 9, the Fund seeks to provide exposure to the spot price of TRX, the native utility token of the TRON blockchain network. In addition, the Fund also seeks to earn additional TRX through participation in the TRON network’s delegated proof-of-stake validation process, with net staking rewards reflected in the Fund’s net asset value. “We appreciate Canary Capital’s leadership in bringing TRX to the ETF market,” said Justin Sun, founder of TRON. “The launch demonstrates growing recognition of the TRON network as critical infrastructure for the global digital economy by giving institutions a new way to participate in the network that is already supporting significant real-world financial activity. Thank you Cboe team. Thank you to the Canary Capital team and every builder and collaborator across the TRON ecosystem who worked hard to make this happen.” TRON has emerged as one of the leading blockchain networks for stablecoin activity, supporting more than $94 billion in circulating Tether (USDT). The chain also processes the highest USDT transfer volume of any blockchain, totaling approximately $6.1 trillion year-to-date. Known for its speed, scalability, and low transaction costs, the TRON network serves as critical infrastructure for decentralized finance, global payments, and blockchain-based applications. For more information on TRXS, click here. About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps. Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of September 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 405 million in total user accounts, more than 15 billion in total transactions, and over $28 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. title: MEXC Unveils “WE SEE YOU” Brand Visual Refresh, Putting People Behind Every Trade in Focus
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, September 29, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, today announced a visual refresh of its brand centered on “WE SEE YOU.” The new identity shifts the focus from accounts and trading activity to the people behind them. Beyond the visuals, “WE SEE YOU” gives a more human expression to a philosophy MEXC has long put into practice: seeing the person behind every account. In a business measured by volume, accounts and activity, it is easy for a person to become a label such as Trader, VIP, Whale or UID. With “WE SEE YOU,” MEXC is taking a different approach, allowing the brand itself to step back and bringing the individual into focus, someone with their own goals, choices and life beyond the screen. The idea is simple: “MEXC sees more than a trader. We see you.” This visual refresh continues the brand evolution MEXC began in April, when the company marked its eighth anniversary with a new logo. Retaining the familiar M and signature blue, the new identity centers on four ideas: more possibilities, more accessible, more open, and more connected. Its outline draws on the infinity symbol, while the two loops also suggest two zeros, reflecting MEXC’s Infinite Opportunities and 0 Fees brand promises. The latest refresh extends that evolution beyond the logo and across MEXC’s broader visual system, with real people taking center stage and brand elements deliberately stepping back. “As a trading platform, MEXC looks beyond the transaction to the people behind every account, understanding what they need and continuing to build around them. For MEXC, ‘WE SEE YOU’ is more than a visual idea. It reflects how we think about the people behind every account,” said Vugar Usi, CEO of MEXC. “Our role is not simply to provide access to markets, but to understand what people need as they participate in them. This refresh gives that belief a clearer and more human expression.” The refreshed visual identity begins with the release of MEXC’s new brand film, “WE SEE YOU,” on September 29, and will make its first offline appearance at TOKEN2049 Singapore. Beyond the launch, MEXC will invite its global community to join the campaign by sharing who they are beyond the trading screen through real photos, everyday identities, and personal stories. In this way, “WE SEE YOU” extends beyond a visual refresh, inviting the people behind the accounts to become part of how the MEXC brand is expressed. About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway. With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity. title: Citi And Coinbase Bring Stablecoin Payments Into Corporate Banking
summary: Citi and Coinbase have expanded their partnership with new stablecoin and fiat payment infrastructure for businesses. Citi clients can accept stablecoin payments while Coinbase provides blockchain rails and conversion into fiat. Coinbase business customers can also use Citi-powered virtual accounts that automatically move between fiat and stablecoins.
